items.title: Brass Bugle with a Navy Cord
items.alt: A polished brass bugle rests across an open blank book beside a coiled navy cord and tassel.
items.description: The instrument's broad flared bell faces right while its mouthpiece extends to the left. Warm metal highlights contrast with the cream pages and the dark braided loop gathered into a long fabric tassel.

items.title: Thank You Veterans Recognition Plaque
items.alt: A walnut-colored plaque carries Thank You Veterans lettering on a gold panel with a star, leaves and a navy bow.
items.description: The three-line message fills the center of the freestanding decorative plaque. Curved golden branches flank its dark wooden edge above layered navy-and-burgundy ribbon folds and a stepped base.

items.title: Happy Veterans Day Greeting Card
items.alt: A Happy Veterans Day card with red poppies stands beside a small American flag, a brown envelope and a navy pen.
items.description: Flowing navy calligraphy fills the upright cream card above two bright poppies. A brass desk stand supports the flag behind it, balancing the closed kraft envelope and gold-trimmed fountain pen.

items.title: Veterans Day Appreciation Rosette
items.alt: A navy-and-cream pleated rosette surrounds a gold center marked Veterans Day beneath a red star.
items.description: Two burgundy ribbon tails hang below the layered fabric circle, each edged with fine gold trim. The decorative appreciation badge has no named award, service branch or rank.

items.title: Veterans Day Stitched Lettering
items.alt: Textured red and navy felt letters spell Veterans Day on a cream appliqué panel with poppies and ribbon tails.
items.description: Small visible stitches follow the edges of the soft fabric letters and scalloped backing. Two red poppies overlap the lower corner, with pale ribbon ends extending beneath the word Day.

items.title: Thank You Veterans with an American Flag
items.alt: A navy ribbon bearing gold-edged Thank You Veterans letters stretches below a waving American flag.
items.description: The wide ribbon curls outward beyond both sides of the flag, exposing its cream edging and deep blue folds. A gold finial tops the pole beside the blue canton and red-and-white stripes.
